name: Cathay Cargo
description: The 2015 Cathay brushwing scheme on the freighters with the 2023 cargo title: white, no windows, the dark green fin with the white brushwing, a small green brushwing under the cockpit and 'CATHAY CARGO' in big dark-green serif capitals along the forward fuselage.

logos.description: The brushwing: a white calligraphic wing like a chevron pointing forward, its upper arm a long brush stroke curving up to a fine tip at the top near the trailing edge with ragged dry-brush edges, its lower arm short and straight back to a point at the fin's root by the trailing edge. Faces forward on both sides.
A small green brushwing under the cockpit windows, ahead of the first door, pointing forward.

titles.style: Large dark-green serif capitals (the Cathay house serif), widely spaced, along the forward main deck below the hump.

notes: The passenger 2015 scheme (fin, engines, brushwing) with the freighter title. Since June 2023 'CATHAY CARGO' replaces 'CATHAY PACIFIC CARGO' (cargo-2015) at repaints: in 2024-2026 Commons photos B-LIA, B-LIB, B-LIE, B-LIF, B-LJB, B-LJK and B-LJN wear it, while ten 747-8Fs still carry the older title. Measured on a 747-8F, whose upper-deck hump makes heights approximate. Not drawn: the small Swire mark and registration aft, and the 2026 '80 years together' badge. B-LJE flies a 2026 80th-anniversary retro (green stripes, 'CATHAY PACIFIC' in red), not this scheme. Re-checked 2026-11-15: the title's start and length agree with a second photo to within 0.01; heights left, since the 747's hump has no measured shape yet.
history: The freighter title changed with the 2023 Cathay Cargo brand (B-LJN first, June 2023); it replaces cargo-2015 at repaints.
